title: AlphaSights Named to FT Europe's Long-Term Growth Champions 2026
summary: AlphaSights was named to the Financial Times' Europe's Long-Term Growth Champions 2026, recognizing exceptional revenue growth from 2014 to 2024. The expert network achieved a 70% revenue CAGR from 2009-2023 and raised $400M at a $4.2B valuation in September 2024.
